summary: Tested the iter406/407 fixes end to end at the public URL. Granting admin from People WORKS: as admin@5812uganda.org I opened Christopher Ssekito (via /5812global/members?member=257c7ab5...&kind=member), turned ON member-admin-toggle and pressed Save Profile. The toast said 'Profile saved' and GET /api/admin/users then showed his account role as 'admin'. Re-opening him showed the Admin switch ON. BUG: the Role dropdown then showed 'Staff', not 'Coordinator'. Turning the switch OFF and saving changed his account role to 'Staff', not back to 'Coordinator'. I restored him to Coordinator through PUT /api/members/{id}, and both the member row and the user row are now Coordinator. Self photo WORKS. As member@5812uganda.org on /5812global/portal/profile, the camera input uploaded the image, the 'Photo updated' toast appeared, the avatar image loaded, and the photo survived a reload. GET /api/portal/profile returned the same photo_url on user and member. As admin on /5812global/profile, the upload worked and after reload the image showed in profile-photo, user-menu-avatar (top right) and the sidebar avatar. POST /users/<admin id>/photo as the member returned 403. Non-image and unauthenticated uploads were also refused. Comms WORKS: the Organization list shows 10 people and the signed-in admin is not among them. Typing 'kate' narrowed it to 1 person ('1 people'), a nonsense string gave 0 and the empty message, and clearing restored 10. Clicking Katelyn created a DM. Send by mouse click delivered messages on desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844, and elementFromPoint returned send-message-btn both times (the softphone pill did not cover it). Existing tests iter405 and iter406 pass (9), and the new iter407 tests pass (4).

minor.issue: Granting admin overwrites members.role and users.role with 'admin' and keeps the previous staff role nowhere (secondary_roles stays []). So the staff role is lost. See the frontend issue: revoking admin demotes the person to 'Staff' instead of their old role.

The escalation guard only blocks admin-tier roles. A Coordinator (level 6) can set a same-campus person to Manager or Director (above their own level). A Manager can demote an existing admin/Executive Director account to Staff, because nothing checks the target's current role level. The admin console has stricter rules (reset-password refuses targets at or above the caller's level) and this endpoint should match them. No audit entry is written for role or status changes.

ui_bugs.issue: Re-opening a person who was made admin shows Role = 'Staff', not their staff role ('Coordinator'), because memberFormFrom falls back to m.secondary_roles?.[0] || 'Staff' and secondary_roles is never written. Switching Admin OFF and saving then sets the account to 'Staff'. Reproduced: Coordinator -> admin -> OFF -> 'Staff'. Fix: on admin grant, also send secondary_roles:[editMemberForm.role] (or a staff_role field) and have the server persist it to members and users, so it can be restored on revoke.

integration_issues.flow: Open a staff person from Staff & People (/members)
integration_issues.issue: /members now shows only the Guests & Parents, Families, Children, Pending and Family Approvals tabs. There is no staff/members list. Searching 'Ssekito' in the guests tab finds only his guest/parent record (gst_40493516), whose dialog has no admin switch. The member edit dialog could only be reached with the deep link ?member=<id>&kind=member. Check how admins are meant to find a staff person here, and add a Staff tab or a link if one is missing.

issues: The 'My Profile' header and cards sit flush against the sidebar edge (x=196) with no left padding, unlike other pages, which use about 20px.
Rows in the 'Other' (uncategorized) group have no data-testid, and their click handler copies the org-user-* handler (DRY).

action_items: Keep the person's staff role when admin is granted from People (persist secondary_roles or a staff_role field), show it in the Role dropdown on re-open, and restore it when Admin is switched off. Today revoking admin from Christopher (Coordinator) turned him into 'Staff'.

Make the update_member role guard match the admin console: refuse roles above the caller's level and changes to targets at or above the caller's level (unless the caller is a system admin), and write an audit entry for role/status changes.
Make the staff/member records reachable from /members, which has no staff list tab now. Admins can currently reach the Admin switch only by deep link.
Minor: add left padding on the staff /profile page, and add data-testid to the uncategorized org rows in CommsPage.
critical_code_review_comments: core.update_member: account_update copies role from member edits, but ADMIN_TIER only checks the NEW role. Demoting an admin-tier account is unguarded for Managers.

children.upload_user_photo: managers can change any user_id's photo, and there is no explicit organisation check on the target (this relies on org_context scoping of db.users.update_one). Worth a quick cross-org test.
UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx is over 2100 lines and should be split. The Edit tab trigger is gated by canEditStaff but its content by isCoordinator, and the two conditions are not the same.
UnifiedPeoplePage saveEditMember sends the whole form, including group:'', to PUT /members. Empty strings are not None, so they overwrite stored values. Group showed blank for Christopher.

success_rate.frontend: 86% (6/7 checks; the admin-revoke role restore failed)

Open his edit dialog with /5812global/members?member=<member id>&kind=member, then the 'Edit Profile' tab. Restore him to Coordinator afterwards with PUT /api/members/{id} {role:'Coordinator'}. The Organization section is expanded by default, so clicking the toggle collapses it.
rca of the issue: Revoking admin does not restore the staff role. memberFormFrom() expects the staff role in m.secondary_roles[0] while role==='admin'. saveEditMember() sends role:'admin' but no secondary_roles, and update_member writes role:'admin' to both the member and the user. Nothing persists the old role, so re-opening the person shows the 'Staff' fallback and switching off saves 'Staff'. To reproduce: Coordinator -> toggle ON -> save -> re-open (dropdown shows Staff) -> toggle OFF -> save -> the account role is 'Staff'. Fix: persist the prior role (secondary_roles/staff_role) when granting admin.
